id.description: The id of the {@link MlProject} that has at least one model or dataset for the given asset.

name.description: The name of the {@link MlProject} that has at least one model or dataset for the given asset.

liveModel.description: The name of the current Champion {@link ReliabilityMlModel} of the given asset with project {@link #id}.

numberOfModels.description:
The number of {@link ReliabilityMlModel} with a specific {@link MlProject} for the given asset.
Excludes retired models.

lastUpdated.description:
The last {@link ReliabilityMlModel} or Reliability Dataset created in the
{@link MlProject} for the given asset.

numberOfDatasets.description: The number of Reliability Datasets with a specific {@link MlProject} for the given asset.

assetValidationStatus.description: The string representation of the {@link ReliabilityAsset#latestDataValidationRun} status.

fetchLimit.description: Limit for fetching all assigned projects. The default value is set to 200 but can be increased.

assetId.description: The id of the {@link ReliabilityAsset} that the {@link MlProject} belongs to.

title:
Helper type to fetch data for Ml Scenarios Nested Grid on the Models Set up Page.
Fetches project information for a given asset ({@link ReliabilityAsset}) passed to the `fetch` call.
name: MlProjectFetchHelper
